system.description:
During a combat scene, you may spend Style Dice to gain a number of Flourishes equal to its rolled value. Unspent Flourishes are lost when the combat scene ends. A Flourish can be spent on the following options:

  • Bind. When you make a successful attack against an adversary, making them Restrained until they pass a Brawn (15) Reaction Roll
  • Parry. When an adversary makes an attack roll against you, increase your Evasion by your Finesse.
  • Riposte. When an enemy misses you with an attack within Melee, make an attack against them. If this attack deals Severe damage, the enemy must mark an additional Hit Point.
